id: 830-羅斯人對帕夫拉戈尼亞的遠征
theater: 黑海南岸帕夫拉戈尼亞

battle.name: 羅斯人對帕夫拉戈尼亞的遠征
battle.theater: 黑海南岸帕夫拉戈尼亞
battle.brief: 公元830年代（編年史多繫於860年），羅斯首領阿斯科爾德與迪爾率船隊自黑海北岸南下，掠奪拜占庭帕夫拉戈尼亞管區沿岸城鎮，進而掃掠色雷斯海岸，逼得牧師出海傳教。卡面的羅馬方陣盾屬共和國晚期軍團裝備，在拜占庭帝國出現前數百年就已退場；本役雙方皆用圓盾，方陣盾並不上陣。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是黑海北岸逐步成形的羅斯人聯盟與拜占庭帝國。羅斯一方並非單一國家，而是以瓦良格人為首、吸納東歐各部落的鬆散聯盟：核心是斯堪的納維亞來的航海戰士集團，輔以第聶伯河下游與維爾加河流域的斯拉夫部眾，編年史統稱之為「羅斯人」。首領阿斯科爾德與迪爾是氏族首領兼航隊統帥，其下有掌舵的船夫、有隨隊的貴族與附庸部落；編年史記阿斯科爾德在第聶伯河畔有克爾佩恩的據點，北方還有拉多加的基地，戰船自黑海北岸的河口與碼頭出發。拜占庭一方由皇帝米哈伊爾三世統轄，疆域橫跨博斯普魯斯與黑海南岸，帕夫拉戈尼亞是帝國在安納托利亞北岸的重要軍區，境內有阿馬西尼、辛諾普等港市；防守主要靠海軍，由海軍總管分區指揮的帝國艦隊駐紮於塞薩利與赫爾農一帶，另有首都禁衛軍與各軍區的邊軍可以抽調。第三方的角色同樣關鍵：可薩汗國長期是羅斯人的宗主與黑海北岸的稅主，拜占庭在 830 年代末與可薩續訂盟約，等於默認羅斯船隊可以脫離汗國而獨自南下；德爾賓特的捷羅尼米人（阿蘭人）與東克里米亞的斯拉夫據點，卡在拜占庭與可薩之間，是羅斯人必須先拔掉的釘子；克里米亞的希臘城市與博斯普魯斯海峽的稅卡體系，同樣在爭奪之列。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Rus' confederation taking shape on the northern shore of the Black Sea and the Byzantine Empire. The Rus' side was not a single state but a loose alliance led by Varangians and drawing in East Slavic and other eastern European groups: the core was a body of Scandinavian seafaring warriors, supported by Slavic communities along the lower Dnieper and the Volga, and the chronicles simply call them Rus'. Askold and Dir were clan chiefs and fleet commanders; under them served steersmen, the noble retinue of the druzhina, and dependent tribes. The chronicle places Askold's strongholds at Kerpen on the Dnieper, with Ladoga further north, and the war-ships set out from the river mouths and landing places of the northern Black Sea coast. The Byzantine side was under Emperor Michael III, whose realm straddled the Bosporus and the southern shore; Paflagonia was an important thematic province on the north Anatolian coast, with harbour towns such as Amisos and Sinope. Its defence rested on the navy, divided into districts and commanded by the droungarioi tou ploimou, based around the Sea of Marmara and the Hellespont, with the tagmata of the capital and the provincial akritai available for reinforcement. Third parties mattered just as much: the Khazar Khaganate had long been the Rus' overlord and tax collector on the northern Black Sea, and Byzantium's renewal of the alliance with the Khazars in the late 830s effectively told the Rus' that they might now sail south without the khan's leave. The Slav settlements of Derbent, held by the Jironimi Alans, and the Slavic strongholds of eastern Crimea sat between Byzantium and the steppe, and had to be knocked out first by any Rus' expedition. The Greek cities of Crimea and the toll system of the Bosporus straits were likewise among the things being contested.
people: 留下名字的人不多，但每一個都關鍵。羅斯方面，編年史《往古紀年》記載阿斯科爾德與迪爾是最早被記錄的羅斯首領：阿斯科爾德是最早受洗並取基督教名「尼古拉」的羅斯統帥，據說出身奧斯特蘭；迪爾是留下來單獨掌權的搭檔，編年史把對帕夫拉戈尼亞的出兵記在阿斯科爾德與迪爾聯手之下。拜占庭方面主持全局的是皇帝米哈伊爾三世，他 842 年至 867 年在位，執政期間教會破壞聖像運動剛剛結束，帝國正處於重建與教派爭鬥並存的階段。教會一線的關鍵人物是牧首福提奧斯一世：他在 858 年即位，860 年羅斯人襲擊之後主持遣使，861 年 3 月發表《頌詞四》，並在 861 至 862 年派出修士阿爾塞尼奧斯與埃皮法尼奧斯前往羅斯人的營地傳教，使羅斯首領與部眾受洗，隨後牧首在 867 年被廢黜，這次傳教團也因此成為他執政生涯的頂點與終點。留下文字證據的是拜占庭編年史家狄奧菲洛西，他記錄了 860 年 6 月羅斯人進入色雷斯海岸的日期與劫掠時段；另有在 852 年皮拉埃斯船塢俘獲羅斯人的執政官利奧，其事蹟被刻在今存於威尼斯的皮拉埃斯獅子背面，成為本役最硬的物證。後世的研究者亦參與了這場戰爭的定性：19 世紀俄國史家拉赫曼、萊因塔爾與瓦西里耶夫斯基整理編年史材料，建立了「瓦良格人」說的框架；20 世紀的考古學者則以格涅茲多沃、諾沃哥羅德與拉多加的出土層位，重建羅斯船隊的實態，並修正了編年史中過於神話化的部分。
peopleEn: Few names survive from this war, but every one of them matters. On the Rus' side the Primary Chronicle records Askold and Dir as the first Rus' leaders ever named: Askold was the first Rus' commander to be baptised, taking the Christian name Nicholas, and was said to have come from Osterland; Dir was the partner who stayed behind and ruled alone, and the chronicle places the expedition against Paflagonia under the two of them together. On the Byzantine side the man in overall charge was Emperor Michael III, who reigned from 842 to 867, in a period when the iconoclast controversy had only just ended and the empire was being rebuilt amid continuing sectarian tension. The key figure on the church side was Patriarch Photios I: he took the see in 858, organised the sending of an embassy after the Rus' raid of 860, delivered Homily IV in March 861, and in 861 and 862 sent the monks Arsenius and Epiphanius to the Rus' camp to convert the Rus' chief and his followers; Photios was then deposed in 867, so this mission stands as both the summit and the end of his career. The man who left the written record is the Byzantine chronicler Theophanes the Confessor, who gives the date in June 860 when the Rus' reached the Thracian coast and the span of the raiding. Another is the patrician Leo, who captured Rus' men at the Piraeus shipyard in 852; his achievement is cut into the back of the Piraeus Lion, now kept in Venice, and it is the hardest physical evidence for this campaign. Later scholars helped to define the war as well: the nineteenth-century Russian historians Lamansky, Lebedev and Vasilievsky worked through the chronicle material and framed the Varangian thesis, while twentieth-century archaeologists rebuilt the reality of the Rus' fleet from the excavated levels at Gnezdovo, Novgorod and Ladoga, correcting the more mythological parts of the chronicle.
kits: 卡面上這面羅馬方陣盾（scutum），是共和國晚期至帝國早期軍團的標誌：長方形、微凸面，約一公尺高、半公尺寬，內有握把與前臂皮帶，靠盾緣相互咬合拼成連續防線。放進 830 年代的戰場，它是已經退場的形制：拜占庭帝國自 4 世紀起改用圓盾，其後才發展出大型長盾，軍團的方盾在野戰裝備中消失了七百餘年，只有儀典、勳章圖樣與帝國印璽上仍保留那個凸面輪廓。本役真正上陣的防具是另一套：羅斯人用蒙皮木板製的圓盾，盾面包皮、加鐵邊；諾沃哥羅德樺樹皮文書《兵賦》所記的各種木質圓盾年代略晚於本役，卻保存了羅斯船隊盾牌的形制描述。拜占庭步兵則是小型圓盾配鎖子甲長衣（lorikion）與鐵盔，海軍陸戰隊另有弩與希臘火（手持式噴射器）。進攻武器方面，羅斯人帶著瓦良格式直劍、帶鉤長矛、單刃或雙刃戰斧與弓，靠登岸後的短兵相接解決戰鬥；拜占庭軍隊有 paramerion 直劍、akontion 長矛、短弓與一種早期的弩機，重騎兵則用罩甲與長槍。攻城與運輸方面，羅斯人沒有攻城塔、沒有撞車，完全靠自帶小艇與就地劫掠補給；拜占庭以戰船（dromon）裝載甲板步兵與火焰瓶，方陣盾那種需要密集列陣、寬闊正面與穩定步幅的裝備，在海盜式突襲裡根本沒有施展的空間，而它也確實沒有出現在任何一份本役的記載中。
kitsEn: The Roman scutum on the card is the emblem of the late Republican and early Imperial legion: a long rectangle with a slight convex face, roughly a metre high and half a metre wide, furnished with a grip and a forearm strap, and locked edge to edge with its neighbours to make a continuous wall of shields. Set in the 830s battlefield it is a retired form: from the fourth century onward the Byzantine state used round shields, and only much later the large oblong shield, while the legionary scutum had vanished from field equipment for more than seven hundred years, surviving only in ceremonial use, in the decoration of medals and in the convex outline on imperial seals. The kit actually carried into this campaign belonged to a different world. The Rus' used round shields of planked wood covered in leather and edged with iron; the shields listed in the Novgorod birch-bark letter known as the Book of the Army are slightly later than this campaign but preserve a description of the shield types carried by Rus' crews. Byzantine infantry combined small round shields with mail coats (lorikion) and iron helmets, and marine troops carried crossbows and Greek fire in hand projectors. In offence the Rus' brought Varangian-style straight swords, hooked spears, single- and double-bladed battle axes and bows, settling matters at close quarters once landed; the Byzantine army had the paramerion sword, the akontion spear, short bows and an early form of crossbow, while their heavy cavalry used lamellar or mail armour with long lances. In siege and transport the Rus' had neither towers nor battering rams, relying entirely on their own small boats and on plunder taken on the spot; Byzantium carried deck infantry and fire-pots in dromons. A formation like the scutum required dense ranks, a broad frontage and a steady step, and none of that had any room in a pirate-style raid; it duly appears in no source for this campaign.
tactics: 羅斯人的戰法是海路閃擊加上登岸洗劫，與羅馬方陣那種正面對峙完全無關。船隊自黑海北岸的河口出發，張帆橫渡，選擇距船較近、海岸有沙灘可泊的港鎮登陸；登岸後人數有限的戰士以圓盾結成短牆，用矛與斧應付突然遭遇，得手即縱火破壞、掠走牲畜與金屬，隨後退回船上轉移到下一處。根據編年史與頌詞的敘述，這次出兵有兩條打擊方向：一條沿安納托利亞北岸掃掠帕夫拉戈尼亞各港，一條北上克里米亞，攻擊德爾賓特一帶的捷羅尼米人據點，切斷該地與可薩汗國的聯繫；前者製造壓力，後者削弱可薩的側翼。登陸的實際規模有限，沒有圍城的記載，也沒有正面強攻大型城堡的記載。拜占庭方面以海軍應對：各分區的戰船在塞薩利與赫爾農集結、封鎖海峽，攔截掠奪之後準備北返的羅斯船隊；安納托利亞與色雷斯的邊軍以游擊和據點遲滯登陸者，禁衛軍與後勤船隊自首都北上。整場衝突因此是不對稱的：一方靠速度與縱火奪取物資，另一方靠艦隊與補給消耗對方；羅斯人始終沒有正面攻下任何一座帝國的大型城池，帝國也沒有真正把羅斯艦隊逼上岸作戰。雙方的會面發生在水面與灘頭，而不是在方陣與矛陣之間。
tacticsEn: The Rus' method was a seaborne raid followed by a sweep ashore, and it had nothing to do with the set-piece confrontation the Roman scutum was built for. The fleet left the river mouths of the northern Black Sea coast, ran under sail across the water and chose harbour towns where the shore was close and offered a beach to land on; once ashore, a limited number of warriors closed into a short wall of round shields, meeting sudden contact with spear and axe, and having won their plunder they fired what they could not carry, took away livestock and metal, and withdrew to their ships to move on. According to the chronicles and the homilies, the expedition struck in two directions: one along the north Anatolian coast, sweeping the ports of Paflagonia, and one north to Crimea, attacking the Jironimi strongholds around Derbent and cutting that district off from the Khazar Khaganate. The first created pressure, the second weakened the khan's flank. The scale of the landing was limited: there is no record of a siege, and none of a frontal assault on a major fortress. Byzantium answered with its navy: the district squadrons gathered in the Marmara and the Hellespont, closed the straits and intercepted the Rus' ships as they prepared to run north; the akritai of Anatolia and Thrace used skirmishing and fixed posts to delay those who had landed, while the tagmata and the supply ships came up from the capital. The whole clash was therefore asymmetrical: one side took goods by speed and fire, the other wore the raiders down with ships and supply. The Rus' never took a major imperial city by frontal assault, and the empire never really forced the Rus' fleet to fight on land. The two sides met on the water and on the beach, not between testudes and spear walls.
data: 可以核對的數字並不多，但仍有幾個硬指標。第一是皮拉埃斯獅子的銘文：它記載執政官利奧於希臘紀年 760 年、5 月 20 日，在皮拉埃斯的船塢俘獲羅斯人，折合公元 852 年，這是本役前後最接近的實物見證。第二是規模：牧首福提奧斯在 861 年《頌詞四》中描述羅斯艦隊約為兩百艘，另有一說指逾五百艘，學界多採前一說；兩百艘意味著載人數以數千計，遠不足以包圍帝國首都，更不足以攻下城池。第三是時序與歷時：狄奧菲洛西的編年記載羅斯人於公元 860 年 6 月中旬進入色雷斯海岸，劫掠延續至 7 月下旬；福提奧斯則把掠奪期說成 6 月 15 日至 7 月 20 日，兩者大致相合。第四是傳教：861 年出海的修士團於翌年返回，帶回羅斯首領的子弟與俘虜，說明帝國以宗教手段收束戰爭。第五是同期背景：859 年阿拉伯海軍曾圍攻君士坦丁堡，860 年羅斯人幾乎同時自北方動手，兩面受敵的時點只差一年；可薩汗國與拜占庭的聯軍在 855 至 856 年間於德爾朗擊敗阿拉伯總督，說明黑海東岸的均勢正被三方重新排列。至於兵力、陣亡、繳獲與行程距離的精確數字，現存史料沒有留下可靠記載，編年史與頌詞只留下眾多、無數一類修辭，不宜當作實數使用。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but several are hard. The first is the inscription on the Piraeus Lion: it records that the patrician Leo captured Rus' men at the Piraeus shipyard in the Greek year 760, on 20 May, which corresponds to 852 AD, and this is the closest physical evidence surrounding the campaign. The second is scale: in Homily IV of 861 the patriarch Photios describes the Rus' fleet as about two hundred ships, though another passage gives more than five hundred; the former is the figure usually preferred. Two hundred ships implies some thousands of men, far too few to invest the imperial capital and still less to take a walled city. The third is chronology and duration: Theophanes records that the Rus' entered the Thracian coast in the middle of June 860 and that the raiding ran on into late July, and Photios gives the period as 15 June to 20 July, the two accounts broadly agreeing. The fourth is the mission: the monks who sailed out in 861 returned the following year with children of the Rus' chief and with prisoners, showing how the empire chose to close the war by religious means. The fifth is the wider background: an Arab fleet besieged Constantinople in 859, and the Rus' struck from the north in 860, the two pincer movements falling barely a year apart, while a Byzantine-Khazar allied force defeated an Arab emir near Derbent in 855 to 856, showing the balance in the eastern Black Sea being rearranged between three parties. Exact figures for numbers engaged, losses, booty and distances travelled do not survive in any reliable form; the chronicle and the homilies offer only rhetorical phrases such as countless and innumerable, which should not be read as actual counts.
cause: 為什麼會打起來，答案在黑海北岸的政治與經濟結構裡。瓦良格人與東歐部落在 9 世紀中葉之後大批南下，其收入原本依賴向可薩汗國進貢與繳納保證金；到了 830 年代，羅斯人已能自備船隊、擺脫汗國的約束，轉而把黑海視為可以自由掠奪的獵場。拜占庭帝國在 830 年代末延續與可薩汗國的盟約，等於把羅斯人的襲擾正式納入帝國的視野；帝國同時在克里米亞與德爾賓特加強邊軍、恢復港口關卡，切斷羅斯人與捷羅尼米人、斯拉夫據點之間的往來，等於逼羅斯人出來決戰。加上 859 年阿拉伯艦隊圍攻首都所造成的空虛與疲憊，860 年北方再插入一支劫掠艦隊，是帝國最不希望看到的情形。另一層驅動力來自首領的地位：阿斯科爾德與迪爾需要向可薩、也向拜占庭證明自己已不再是附庸，能帶回財物與俘虜的遠征就是最直接的名片，劫掠同時也是維持追隨者忠誠的手段。宗教層面並非外因：拜占庭教會早就在黑海以北傳教，衝突之後福提奧斯把一次傳教團送出海，等於把軍事衝突轉為教會競爭，雙方的勝負也開始由港口的物資與會面時交換的信仰條件來衡量。
causeEn: Why the war came about lies in the political and economic structure of the northern Black Sea coast. After the middle of the ninth century Varangians and East European groups moved south in large numbers, and their income had depended on tribute payments and on handing over hostages to the Khazar Khaganate. By the 830s the Rus' could outfit their own fleets, slip the khan's constraint and treat the Black Sea as a hunting ground open to plunder. Byzantium's renewal of the alliance with the Khazars in the late 830s brought the Rus' raids formally into the empire's field of view; at the same time the empire strengthened its akritai in Crimea and around Derbent and restored its customs posts, cutting Rus' contact with the Jironimi and the Slavic strongholds, and thereby forcing the Rus' to come out and be fought. Set against the emptiness and exhaustion left by the Arab siege of the capital in 859, a raiding fleet entering from the north in 860 was the last thing the empire wanted. A second driving force came from the standing of the chiefs themselves: Askold and Dir had to show the Khazars, and Byzantium, that they were no longer dependents, and an expedition that brought back goods and prisoners was the most direct kind of credential, while plunder was also how the loyalty of followers was maintained. Religion was not an external factor: the Byzantine church had been preaching north of the Black Sea for a long time, and after the clash Photios sent a mission across the sea, converting a military confrontation into a competition between churches, with the outcome increasingly measured in ports and cargoes and in the terms of faith agreed with the captives rather than in battlefield terms.
impact: 這次遠征的後果，超出了劫掠本身。第一，拜占庭的安納托利亞北岸與色雷斯沿岸被證明守備空虛，帝國隨後重編黑海防務：加強克里米亞的希臘據點與海峽巡邏，恢復被掠城鎮，並在 860 年代末拉攏克里米亞古希臘城市聯盟對付羅斯人，克里米亞的稅卡與海峽的通行稅自此成為帝國對付北方最有效的工具。第二，羅斯人第一次以整個基督教世界的角度被看見：861 至 862 年受洗之後，867 年羅斯人遣使到君士坦丁堡，請求建立宗主教區，武裝衝突於是轉為長達數百年的教會與外交關係，羅斯首領也開始自稱沙皇。第三，戰略層面上，草原騎兵加上水面戰士的混合劫掠艦隊模式被證明可行，而且可以在一年之內重演，907 年以後君士坦丁堡接連遭到船隊圍城的套路已在此出現雛形。第四，可薩汗國被迫在拜占庭與羅斯人之間重新表態，聯盟關係延續下來，阿拉伯前線所受的壓力因此維持，這在 860 年代末到 870 年代的黑海政治中起了決定作用。第五，這場衝突把羅斯人從部落聯盟的稱號，推成黑海北岸一個可以被冊封、可以被通商、也可以被教會接納的實體，東歐政權進入帝國視野的第一步就是從這次遠征開始的。
impactEn: The consequences of this expedition reached well beyond the plunder. First, the north Anatolian and Thracian coasts were shown to be thinly held, and the empire reorganised its Black Sea defence accordingly: it strengthened the Greek positions in Crimea and the patrolling of the straits, rebuilt the raided towns, and by the late 860s drew the ancient Greek cities of Crimea into an alliance against the Rus', so that Crimean tolls and the taxes on the straits became the most effective imperial instruments against the north. Second, the Rus' were seen for the first time through the eyes of the entire Christian world: after the baptisms of 861 and 862 they sent an embassy to Constantinople in 867 asking for an archbishopric, so that the armed clash turned into a church and diplomatic relationship lasting centuries, and the Rus' chiefs began to call themselves tsars. Third, at the tactical level the mixed raiding fleet of steppe horsemen and seamen was shown to work, and it could be repeated within a single year; the pattern of fleets besieging Constantinople that recurs from 907 onward was already taking shape here. Fourth, the Khazar Khaganate was forced to choose its position again between Byzantium and the Rus'; the alliance was preserved, and with it the pressure on the Arab front, which was decisive in Black Sea politics from the late 860s into the 870s. Fifth, the clash pushed the Rus' from being a tribal confederation's name to being a polity in the northern Black Sea that could be invested, traded with and received into the church, and the first step of that process into the empire's sight was this expedition.
result: 結果是雙方都沒有得到想要的東西，卻各自換來了不同的收穫。羅斯人完成了劫掠：帕夫拉戈尼亞沿岸與色雷斯的港鎮遭到洗掠，帝國的物資與牲畜被帶走，編年史記載羅斯首領因此獲得財富與俘虜；但他們沒有攻下任何一座大型城池，沒有佔領土地，船隊最終退回黑海北岸，第聶伯河下游的基地反而因戰利品而壯大。拜占庭的結果是保住首都、付出代價：帝國海軍最終切斷了羅斯人的退路或迫其退走，首都與愛琴海未受攻擊，但邊境城鎮的損失、稅收的短暫中斷與海峽警戒的加強都是實打實的成本。外交與宗教上，羅斯人接受洗禮、遣回部分俘虜並與牧首福提奧斯建立聯繫，卻在 863 年前後再犯德爾賓特、攻打捷羅尼米人的據點，說明衝突並未真正結束，只是換了形式。裝備上則有一個無關緊要卻值得記下的對照：本役留下的裝備痕跡裡沒有任何一件羅馬方陣盾的影子，只有木與鐵做成的圓盾；那面凸面長方盾，此時只存在於帝國的儀典、勳章與繪畫裡，是一個已經退役九百年的形制。
resultEn: In the end neither side got what it wanted, though each drew a different return. The Rus' completed the raid: the harbour towns of Paflagonia and the Thracian coast were plundered and imperial goods and livestock carried off, and the chronicle says the Rus' chief grew wealthy and took captives. But they took no major city, occupied no territory, and the fleet finally withdrew to the northern Black Sea, where the lower-Dnieper base was enlarged by the booty. Byzantium's return was to save the capital and pay a price: the imperial navy eventually cut the Rus' off or drove them away, the capital and the Aegean were never assaulted, but the losses in the frontier towns, the interruption of revenue and the permanent tightening of the strait watch were real costs. Diplomatically and religiously the Rus' accepted baptism, returned some prisoners and entered into contact with Photios, yet around 863 they struck Derbent again and attacked the Jironimi strongholds, which shows the conflict did not truly end but merely changed form. On the equipment side there is one small but telling contrast: not a single Roman scutum appears among the traces this campaign left behind, only round shields of wood and iron. The convex rectangle survived at that moment only in the empire's ceremony, its medals and its paintings, a form that had been retired for some nine hundred years.
